gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Noto Sans Meroitic fills its lines with lowercase that stands nearly as tall as capitals, while Redux up top swaggers with wide spacing and big curved entrances. Over a full page it stays friendly and easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi lets light into every curve and keeps capitals and lowercase close in height, while Redux stretches out above it with a slightly weighted stem. Their strongest quality is clarity.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono gives each sturdy, tall lowercase letter its own space, so nothing crowds, while Redux sprawls above in a display style with a modest thick-thin rhythm. A long page would move along steadily and cleanly.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-mro: Wide letter spacing and big curved entrances mark Redux, a display face with moderate, readable contrast, while Noto Sans Mro below packs dense, tall middles into its words. The heading sprawls and the plain sans tightens.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-multani: Redux spreads its letters wide and swings into each curve with a generous entrance, while Noto Sans Multani sits beneath with a lofty x-height and an open-ended e. One is made for display; the plain sans is made for reading.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Noto Sans Myanmar lays down a thick, heavy-looking band of text with a broad, welcoming c, and Redux above it softens every curve with gentle contrast. Over a long stretch, the plain sans reads sturdy and clear.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Tall, wide, confident: Redux spaces its letters out and enlarges its lowercase for a bold display look, with joins that taper only modestly. And Noto Sans Nabataean reads steadily over a long stretch, its near cap-tall lowercase and open s curves keeping each line clear.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundar: Reading Noto Sans Nag Mundari feels like seeing half-unwrapped c and s shapes and lowercase that rivals the capitals. Redux brings a comfortable thick-thin variation up top, and the sans-serif body holds its own beneath.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-nandinagar: Redux has a lowercase a with gently varied stroke weights, set in wide spacing and a big curved entrance, while Noto Sans Nandinagari keeps generous openings and short ascenders below. Their strongest quality is friendly openness.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-newa: Noto Sans Newa reads with a clearly open e and tall bowls. Redux adds soft shifts in thickness that never turn stark, and the plain sans keeps that gentleness steady throughout; roominess is their strongest quality.
